set -e
cd /opt/ai-relay
echo '' | base64 -d | gunzip | sudo tee /tmp/fix-jev-ratio.py >/dev/null
sudo docker run --rm -v /opt/ai-relay/data/new-api:/data -v /tmp/fix-jev-ratio.py:/tmp/fix.py:ro python:3.12-alpine python /tmp/fix.py /data/one-api.db
# bounce new-api to clear option cache
NAME=$(sudo docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E 'new-api|one-api' | head -1 || true)
if [ -n "$NAME" ]; then sudo docker restart "$NAME"; sleep 3; fi
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/pricing | python3 -c "
import sys,json
j=json.load(sys.stdin)
m=next((x for x in j.get('data',[]) if x.get('model_name')=='jev-1.13.0'), None)
mr=float((m or {}).get('model_ratio') or -1); cr=float((m or {}).get('completion_ratio') or -1)
print('pricing', mr, cr, 'sell_in', mr*2, 'sell_out', mr*2*cr)
assert abs(mr-0.0168)<1e-9 and cr==0, (mr, cr, m)
print('OK_JEV_RATIO')
"
echo DONE_FIX_JEV_RATIO
